parameters.content:
## Review Requests (template)
Test mode is ON by default. Nothing is sent: would-be texts go to data/logs/outbox.jsonl.

Google policy built in: no incentives (templates with incentive words are refused), no gating (every customer gets the same link, in the first text and in both happy/unhappy auto-replies). Unhappy replies also alert the owner privately.

1 request ~2h after the job (inside business hours, outside quiet hours), max 1 per customer per 90 days, 1 follow-up after 3 days if no reply.

main.node: TEST: Log Would-Be SMS + Owner Alert
